text:
raj-cloud: Heads-up — Nimbus Cloud submitted a formal request to onboard the nimbus-eu-3 region into the marketplace. They want initial capacity (GPU quota + dedicated tenant bandwidth) and KMS integration. Pilot target: week of Apr 5. Can we triage?

elaine-sales: Ack. Do we have the partner's legal/tech contacts and a public launch ask? Any co-announcement planned? :eyes:

raj-cloud: Summary + partner link: https://nimbus.example/req/4321. They indicated a small co-announcement for pilot customers only. Legal will need to approve messaging. Tech contact is anna@nimbus (cc in the partner portal).

mike-ops: Quick skim — requested SKUs/quotas below. Cloud quota requests usually take ~3-7 business days depending on region and provider. If we need dedicated capacity reservations we'll need procurement signoff.

```
Requested quota:
- 40 x A100-80GB (initial reserve)
- 8 x V100 fallbacks
- 2TB net egress burst per hour
- KMS: external customer-managed key allowed
- Marketplace listing + entitlement for org-scoped access
```

sarah-legal: OK. We'll need an NDA addendum for marketplace entitlements + the co-announcement approval workflow. I'll draft an addendum and an announcement review checklist. Who owns partner comms?

elaine-sales: I'll own comms and partner PR flow. Sales will prepare the one-pager and customer pilot invite list. Need legal sign-off before we share any joint collateral.

tom-eng: From runtime side: model variants validated on eu-west2 hardware, but we need perf runs on the exact host/image in eu-3. Also small kernel-selection tweak to avoid a perf cliff at 2k tokens — I can submit a PR. No blocker for marketplace listing otherwise.

raj-cloud: Great. Action owners: mike-ops => quota & infra booking; tom-eng => perf runs + PR; sarah-legal => NDA addendum + PR approval flow; elaine-sales => partner comms & pilot list. I'll coordinate partner sync and update Nimbus once quota request is sent.

nimbus-partner-bot: Partner ticket #NIM-4321 created (status: waiting_on_provider_quota). Contact: anna@nimbus. Estimated partner lead time: 5 business days.

mike-ops: Plan: open provider quota ticket Mon AM (REF: QC-4321). If quota approved Wed, infra prep Thu-Fri, smoke test Sat, soft pilot Mon. Will flag any procurement requirements early.

tom-eng: I'll run perf bench Monday against a 2k seq using the eu-3 image and post results here. If we see degradation >10% we'll apply kernel flag and rebench.

sarah-legal: Please DM partner contact details or drop them in the partner portal. I'll aim to have the NDA addendum draft by Thu EOD.

elaine-sales: Pilot go/no-go target: Apr 12 for soft-launch to pilot customers. Sales prep in progress. :thumbsup:

raj-cloud: Sounds good — I'll run the partner kickoff call Tues 9am PT and publish a short playbook after the quota ticket is opened. Ping me if anything blocks.

mike-ops: Opening provider ticket Mon and looping in cloud account team. Will update this thread with ticket ID and ETA.

tom-eng: PR #6789 will contain the kernel-selection toggle and a short bench script.

raj-cloud: Thanks everyone. :raised_hands: Ping me for escalations — otherwise I'll post updates after the quota ticket is live.
